visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium shot depicts two men in a professional, sound-dampened recording studio. One man sits in the foreground wearing a black cap, glasses, and a gray sweatshirt, facing a workstation. The second man stands behind him, wearing a denim jacket and large headphones, singing into a large condenser microphone. (2) The camera cuts to a closer view of the seated man as he turns around to speak to the singer, gesturing with his hands to emphasize technical points. The standing man listens while holding a smartphone, his face showing focus. (3) The seated man demonstrates a specific mouth shape and vocal technique, with the lighting being soft and even across the room. The standing man adjusts his headphones. (4) The shot shifts back to the singer as he attempts the line again, looking down at his phone for lyrics. The background shows neutral-colored soundproofing panels. (5) In the final phase, the seated man provides further guidance with animated hand motions before standing up, indicating the conclusion of the recording segment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice sings melodic lyrics with a soft, breathy texture. Background music consists of a simple acoustic piano progression at a moderate tempo. (2) A second male voice interrupts with a lower pitch and professional tone to provide feedback on the 'emotion' and 'directness' of the vocal take. The music continues at a lower volume. (3) The first male voice repeats a line, focusing on lighter dynamics as instructed. The producer speaks again, mentioning mouth shape for better articulation. (4) More technical feedback follows regarding timing and the 'straight' nature of the singing. The speaker emphasizes 'breath before words.' (5) The session concludes with a conversational closing remark about the difficulty of recording, while the acoustic background track remains consistent in its loop.
